traps.naive_sql:
WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT o.* FROM biz.orders o JOIN biz.customers c USING (customer_id)
  WHERE NOT c.is_test_account AND o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at IS NOT NULL
), denominator AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM eligible
  WHERE paid_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-08-01 00:00:00+08'

)

FROM eligible o JOIN biz.refunds r USING (order_id)
WHERE r.status <> 'rejected'

  AND o.paid_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-01 00:00:00+08';

traps.naive_sql:
WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.promo_id, EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM biz.refunds r WHERE r.order_id = o.order_id
      AND r.status <> 'rejected'
      AND r.requested_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-12-15 00:00:00+08'
  ) AS refunded
  FROM biz.orders o JOIN biz.customers c USING (customer_id)
  WHERE o.region_id = 3 AND NOT c.is_test_account AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
    AND o.paid_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-08-01 00:00:00+08'
    AND o.paid_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-01 00:00:00+08'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE refunded) AS refunded_orders,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE refunded)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS rate
FROM cohort;
traps.correct_sql:
WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.promo_id, EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM biz.refunds r WHERE r.order_id = o.order_id
      AND r.status <> 'rejected'
      AND r.requested_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-12-15 00:00:00+08'
  ) AS refunded
  FROM biz.orders o JOIN biz.customers c USING (customer_id)
  WHERE o.region_id = 3 AND NOT c.is_test_account AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
    AND o.paid_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-08-01 00:00:00+08'
    AND o.paid_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-01 00:00:00+08'
)
SELECT COALESCE(promo_id = 17, FALSE) AS is_promo_17,
  COUNT(*) AS orders, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE refunded) AS refunded_orders,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE refunded)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS rate
FROM cohort GROUP BY COALESCE(promo_id = 17, FALSE)
ORDER BY is_promo_17;
